summary: Iter46 verified the title-weighted / length-normalized retrieval with 2-chunk-per-doc cap, buffered LLM streaming (120 char), and deterministic grounded-excerpt fallback. Initial pytest run reproduced the bug (2/10 failed) because LLM was HTTP 429 rate-limited (Gemini free-tier quota exhausted) and the `except Exception` branch in POST /api/student/ai-chat/stream event_stream returned OUT_OF_SCOPE unconditionally without checking retrieved chunks — bypassing the grounded excerpt fallback. Also found stopword gap ('bagaimana') which made the genuine unrelated rendang question match KEBIJAKAN PRIVASI once we started returning grounded excerpt on exception. Applied 2 minimal fixes: (a) server.py except-branch now emits grounded excerpt when chunks exist; (b) rag_service.py stop_words extended with Indonesian question words (bagaimana/kenapa/mengapa/kapan/dimana/siapa/adalah/akan/sudah/juga/saja/kah/tidak/bukan). After fixes all 10 tests in existing test file pass, plus a new 3x repetition test (test_iter46_repeated_runs.py) confirms 3/3 syarat + 3/3 program grounded and rendang returns exact fallback. UI verified: syarat question in StudentAiChatWidget streams grounded answer citing SYARAT DAN KETENTUAN (TERMS & CONDITIONS).pdf; rendang question shows exact fallback.

rca of the issue: Reproduction: after iter45 retrieval fix, LLM Gemini call in /api/student/ai-chat/stream raised RateLimitError (429 quota exceeded). event_stream's `except Exception` block at server.py:6522 set answer=OUT_OF_SCOPE_MESSAGE unconditionally and streamed it — bypassing the new elif branch (line 6517) that replaces OUT_OF_SCOPE with grounded excerpt when chunks exist. User saw only the fallback despite retrieval returning the correct SYARAT/PRIVASI/PAKTA sources. Mitigation applied: (1) except branch now checks `if chunks:` and returns `Berdasarkan referensi {sources[0]}: {chunks[0]['text'][:850]}` so any LLM failure with retrieved chunks still yields a grounded citation. (2) rag_service.reference_tokens stop_words extended with Indonesian interrogatives so genuinely off-topic questions (e.g. 'Bagaimana resep memasak rendang…') don't accidentally match on 'bagaimana' → still return exact OUT_OF_SCOPE_MESSAGE.
